title: Protesters Throw Projectiles at Biden During Dublin Trip
summary_full: Video showed demonstrators from a pro-Palestinian protest throwing projectiles at former President Joseph R. Biden Jr. after he attended an event at Trinity College Dublin on Tuesday.
